title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to quickly clear/remove all breakpoints in VS Code
summary: VS Code debugging for Business Central allows developers to set breakpoints to pause code execution. This post explains two methods to clear all breakpoints at once: using the Remove All Breakpoints button in the Breakpoints tab, or adding a custom keyboard shortcut since the feature lacks a default shortcut like Visual Studio's Ctrl+Shift+F9.
key_points: Breakpoints pause code execution when the debugger reaches them, helping developers inspect application behavior
The Breakpoints tab has a Remove All Breakpoints button for bulk clearing without removing breakpoints individually
VS Code doesn't have a default shortcut for removing all breakpoints, but you can add a custom one through File > Preferences > Keyboard Shortcuts
Custom shortcuts like Alt+B can replicate Visual Studio's Ctrl+Shift+F9 functionality in VS Code

quotes.text: The basic concept in debugging is the breakpoint, which is a mark that you set on a statement.
